# Offroad Package Delivery

> Offroad Package Delivery gets packages to people in remote places, from the jungle to the desert. The app shows new, upcoming and delivered packages, and lets you add and edit deliveries.

## Pages

- [Deliveries](/): Overview of all deliveries grouped by status (new, in transit, delivered), with a details panel to view, add and edit a delivery
- [About](/about): What Offroad Package Delivery is
